presentation.speaker: henri_dubois
presentation.title: Low-season slump
lines: Bookings have dried up. You can discount or wait for the season to turn.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.outcome: Demand is lower for four weeks, then returns on its own.

choices.label: Run a $1,800 discount campaign
choices.outcome: The promotion softens the dip for two weeks, then it fades.
